select * from article
state = '已发布'
and category_id = #{categoryId}
and (title like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or summary like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by create_time desc

select date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, count(*) as count from article where state = '已发布' and create_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval 6 day) group by date_format(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by date

select c.category_name as categoryName, count(a.id) as articleCount from category c left join article a on a.category_id = c.id and a.state = '已发布' group by c.id, c.category_name order by articleCount desc, c.category_name
select * from article where state = '已发布' order by view_count desc, create_time desc limit #{limit}
